run_json_teacher: run the JsonTeacher class to load conversation data from a JSONL file for Parlai dialogue tasks
configure_jsonfile_datapath: configure the JsonTeacher with a jsonfile-datapath argument to specify the data file location
set_label_turns: set the label-turns argument to firstspeaker, secondspeaker, or both for training labels
use_datatype_extension: enable the jsonfile-datatype-extension flag to auto-append _train, _valid, or _test suffixes to the data file
create_default_teacher: create a DefaultTeacher instance as an alias for JsonTeacher to load JSON conversation data
